package internalapi

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
)

type learningPathPlanningHTTPStub struct {
	studentID  string
	pathID     string
	replan     studentuc.LearningPathReplanInput
	completion studentuc.LearningPathNoGapInput
	err        error
}

func (stub *learningPathPlanningHTTPStub) Get(
	_ context.Context, studentID, pathID string,
) (domain.LearningPathPlanningState, error) {
	stub.studentID, stub.pathID = studentID, pathID
	return domain.LearningPathPlanningState{Schema: domain.LearningPathPlanningStateSchema}, stub.err
}

func (stub *learningPathPlanningHTTPStub) Replan(
	_ context.Context, input studentuc.LearningPathReplanInput,
) (domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandResult, error) {
	stub.replan = input
	return domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandResult{Schema: domain.LearningPathCommandResultSchema}, stub.err
}

func (stub *learningPathPlanningHTTPStub) CompleteNoGap(
	_ context.Context, input studentuc.LearningPathNoGapInput,
) (domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandResult, error) {
	stub.completion = input
	return domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandResult{Schema: domain.LearningPathCommandResultSchema}, stub.err
}

func TestExactPathPlanningReadRequiresDedicatedPlannerToken(t *testing.T) {
	stub := &learningPathPlanningHTTPStub{}
	router := NewRouter(&Handler{LearningPathPlanning: stub}, "general-token", "planner-token")
	path := "/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/learning-paths/" +
		"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222/planning-state"
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name   string
		token  string
		status int
	}{
		{name: "general token", token: "general-token", status: http.StatusForbidden},
		{name: "planner token", token: "planner-token", status: http.StatusOK},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil)
			request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", testCase.token)
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
			if response.Code != testCase.status {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d want=%d body=%s", response.Code, testCase.status, response.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
	if stub.studentID != "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111" ||
		stub.pathID != "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222" {
		t.Fatalf("read was not exact-path scoped: %+v", stub)
	}
}

func TestExactPathReplanForwardsStrictVersionAndIdempotencyIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	stub := &learningPathPlanningHTTPStub{}
	router := NewRouter(&Handler{LearningPathPlanning: stub}, "general-token", "planner-token")
	body := `{
      "schema":"student-learning-path-replan.v1",
      "planning_request_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
      "course_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
      "goal_code":"go.backend",
      "course_fingerprint":"fingerprint-v1",
      "planner_policy_version":"planner-v2",
      "reason_code":"replan",
      "reason_summary":"Refresh route",
      "expected_version":7,
      "items":[{"reference_type":"lesson","reference_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555","position":0,"status":"READY","targets":[],"reason_code":"next_gap"}]
    }`
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPut,
		"/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/learning-paths/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		strings.NewReader(body))
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "planner-token")
	request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK || stub.replan.ExpectedPathVersion != 7 ||
		stub.replan.PlanningRequestID != "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333" ||
		stub.replan.IdempotencyKey != "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666" ||
		stub.replan.LearningPathID != "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222" {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d input=%+v body=%s", response.Code, stub.replan, response.Body.String())
	}
}

func TestExactPathNoGapRejectsReplanFieldsAndMapsConflict(t *testing.T) {
	stub := &learningPathPlanningHTTPStub{}
	router := NewRouter(&Handler{LearningPathPlanning: stub}, "general-token", "planner-token")
	path := "/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/learning-paths/" +
		"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222/completion"
	body := `{"schema":"student-learning-path-no-gap.v1","planning_request_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","course_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444","goal_code":"go.backend","course_fingerprint":"fingerprint-v1","planner_policy_version":"planner-v2","reason_code":"mastery_no_gap","reason_summary":"Already mastered","expected_version":2}`

	unknownFieldRequest := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPut, path, strings.NewReader(strings.TrimSuffix(body, "}")+`,"items":[]}`))
	unknownFieldRequest.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "planner-token")
	unknownFieldResponse := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(unknownFieldResponse, unknownFieldRequest)
	if unknownFieldResponse.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
		t.Fatalf("unknown no-gap field status=%d body=%s", unknownFieldResponse.Code, unknownFieldResponse.Body.String())
	}

	stub.err = domain.ErrConflict
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPut, path, strings.NewReader(body))
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "planner-token")
	request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusConflict {
		t.Fatalf("conflict status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
}
